claims.text: The Black Vault's landing page for OASD FOIA case 97-F-1677, released September 1997, describes records of numerous unidentified craft over Malmstrom AFB in November 1975 that could not be intercepted by multiple F-106 fighters. THE PAGE ITSELF REPRODUCES NO DOCUMENT TEXT, so the non-interception claim is corroborated here by the NORAD log rather than by that page.

edges.note: The USAF fact sheet states Blue Book was terminated on 17 December 1969 on the conclusion that no UFO had ever indicated a threat to national security. The 1975 records document unidentified objects over nuclear weapons installations.
